text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 82, January 04, 1937 ]
REVOKING EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 41, DATED JUNE 29, 1936
WHEREAS, in Commonwealth Act Numbered thirty-eight, appropriating funds for the necessary expenses of
the Government of the Philippines during the nineteen hundred and thirty-seven, the National Assembly has
placed the Bureau of Prisons under the Department of Justice instead of under the Philippine Army or under
the Office of the President, notwithstanding the provisions of Executive Order Numbered Forty-one, dated
June twenty-ninth, nineteen hundred thirty-six, ratified by it;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, MANUEL L. QUEZON, President of the Philippines, do hereby revoke Executive
Order Numbered Forty-one, dated June twenty-ninth, nineteen hundred thirty-six, thereby returning to the
Department of Justice the administrative supervision over the Bureau of Prisons: Provided, however, That
Major General Paulino Santos Chief of Staff of the Philippine Army, shall continue in his detail as Director of
Prisons, and shall exercise as heretofore all authority, and be entitled to all the privileges, of the said office.
Done at the City of Manila, this fourth day of January, in the year of the Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
thirty-seven, and of the Commonwealth of the Philippines, the second.
(Sgd.) MANUEL L. QUEZON
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(Sgd.) ELPIDIO QUIRINO
Secretary of the Interior
